bevel.description: Defaults to 8% of the shortest edge, clamped to 0.03–0.2 m.

nightLamp.description: Explicitly marks this box as a lamp diffuser for the night emissive pass.

segments.description: Defaults to 12–32 segments, increasing with radius.

w.description: Post spacing per panel in metres, along local X.
